reference.sourceKind: static disassembly analysis, no emulator timing trace

interpretation.frameId: Source graphics frame, NOT R15/R6 animation or tile ID
interpretation.displayAdvance: One literal frame byte; control commands consume no extra display advance
interpretation.timing: Caller FrameCounter mask controls pointer advance; interruption/lag/phase can change elapsed time
interpretation.damage: E2 events are opportunities; only authoritative source latch/contact confirms a successful effect
interpretation.proportions: See canonical visual source sheet/metadata; frame IDs alone do not establish mesh dimensions
interpretation.callerPostprocessing: Some callers transform frame values (Walker articulated geometry; bosses OR0x80). Decode the caller before treating an ID as a complete sprite frame.
